recommendation: RECOMMENDED PRIME. Cleanest remaining known-classical gap with maximal infra carry-over: the classical pigeonhole proof is a two-line argument over Fin r × Fin s labelling each index i by (a_i, b_i) = (longest nondecreasing subsequence ending at i, longest nonincreasing ...); injectivity on any r·s window forces a monotone run of length r or s. Everything is decidable and finite; no witness search, no certified compute, no SAT — the whole proof is hand combinatorics in Lean, the same profile as the OPE-44 R(3,3) pigeonhole argument which closed green.
